# M3 and M4 evidence obligations

**ID:** `mandate.evidence-obligations-m3-m4`
**Status:** `mandate`
**Depends on:** `mandate.milestone-order`, `mandate.binding-constraints`

M3 must exercise every supported succession cause through effective law, office rebinding, player-control transfer, official-state continuity, and private-state separation. It must prove distinct chairmanship dossiers, inherited burdens, no soft reset, score persistence across save and succession, immutable finding entries, non-duplication, hidden-subject protection, compensating adjustments, non-causality, and the terminal undispositioned-review rule.

M4 must prove that every sovereign in a dated world profile has one non-owning,
non-cognitive identity root and a complete typed coarse component bundle.
Passive roots may not enter universal dispatch. Component ownership, required
state, fidelity compatibility, relationships, accounts, transitions, and
fallback mappings must close across Rust models, catalog permission, and the
manifest.

Each external political channel must declare `RECORDED` or `RESPONSIVE`.
Recorded channels must prove that no player-reachable feedback exists.
Responsive channels must persist every behaviorally relevant state value,
consume every supported intervention, and emit witnessed outputs. Rich
promotion must replace exact coarse or residual shares; demotion must
deterministically reconcile accounts, stocks, relationships, commitments,
queues, observations, and pending effects while recording fidelity loss.

M4 must also prove UTC event ordering against local calendars, sessions,
cutoffs, and settlement; feasible-project envelopes reject unregistered
geography and technology; and dated instances freeze reusable templates,
source cutoffs, provider modes, and content identity. Asset evidence must
validate approved source references, rights and metadata, pinned import
settings, excluded generated caches, and separate presentation identity.
Broader content must close period variants, counterparties, opening state,
fallbacks, supported transitions, and probes before scenario use.

Transferable-learning evidence remains research: where mechanisms have genuinely different regimes, observe whether players inspect distinguishing institutionally obtainable evidence in sibling and holdout fixtures rather than repeat memorized packages.

The Gulf historical lenses and Hormuz template remain planning records until
those M4 obligations validate. Their catalog presence proves neither scenario
availability nor calibration.
